About the data

Coverage currently covers the eight WAEMU countries; the Central African (CEMAC) countries and the Comoros will follow. The Council of Europe Development Bank is not included: it lends only to its European member states. Data updated . If the globe does not appear on your device, use the "Switch to 2D map" button. Data refreshes on the 1st of every month at the same address. Amounts are commitments in euros. Multi-country deals without published country shares are split equally and marked as estimates. Regional deals that only mention a WAEMU country are listed but not counted in totals. Arcs end at each country's capital.
